title: Integrated heating and cooling
description: Geothermal doublet with a heat exchanger heats the water of a heating network; a heat pump on the brine, a peak boiler and two hot-water-driven chillers (absorption and adsorption) sit in series on the hot water, a compression chiller (heat pump in cooling mode) joins them on the chilled water, and the heating and cooling consumers close each side. Every unit after the heat exchanger has an 'enabled' parameter; sizes are parameters. Heat rejection circuits and the network returns are plant inlets. Storage is not included: it needs a state connection.
